paragraphs: Aybuke is an iPhone and iPad app, also built for the Mac with Mac Catalyst, for AI photo editing and AI image generation, with free on-device effects and video editing, made for girls who glow.
Working on this repository with an AI agent (or new to it)? Start with AGENTS.md: what the app is, where the code lives, how to build and test, the rules and what's next.
features: Say it, see it: "give me pink hair", "add soft glam makeup", "put me in a pink dress". "Ideas for this photo" suggests effects, looks and edits that fit the picture (worked out on the device), and Surprise me tries free…

One-tap looks: 50+ trends such as Doll Box, Y2K Digicam, Bow Era, Sticker Sheet, Plushie Me, Fairy Princess, bestie looks like Sleepover and pet portraits, plus seasonal looks (Halloween, winter, Galentine's) promoted…

Dream it, create it: turn any idea into art with 20 styles, from Pastel Dream and Kawaii to Watercolor, Sticker and Cozy Knit. With Apple Intelligence, Inspire me and Make it magic write ideas and better prompts on the…

Retro effects: free on-device effects from the 80s to the 2010s (VHS '86, Disposable '98, Kira Kira, Digicam '04, Instant '82, Glamour '92, Neon '84, Throwback '16, Camcorder '06, Toy Cam '09, Rainbow '17 and Film…
Simple video editing: auto-cut the silences (a jump cut), add a retro effect, trim, then save to Photos or share. Free and on-device, with no watermark and no ending clip, for clips up to 5 minutes.

requirements.text: No sign-up: an anonymous account is created only at the first cloud edit or purchase, and Delete my data removes everything.
Sign in with Apple (credits on every device; Pro always follows the Apple Account) is built but switched off in this version (signInWithApple in AppConfig.json).
